purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches found first-party Dongyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and Real Estate Registration Center evidence, plus Zhejiang's official GIS platform. The current public application was inspected through its HTML and linked JavaScript/configuration routes, but no anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or native ID field was found. No GeoJSON is retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is evidenced, so registryFound is true. Dongyang government pages publish real-estate registration notices under the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and identify the Real Estate Registration Center. This does not establish open parcel geometry or runtime adapter readiness.

Inspected public scripts including areaSystem.js; they exposed platform/site lookup routes but not a safe anonymous cadastral feature service, schema, CRS, or native parcel ID field. No endpoint was guessed or probed beyond documented routes.

geometryDecision.details: No anonymous safe parcel geometry response with stable native identity, schema, and CRS was found; no GeoJSON retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dongyang municipal natural-resources and real-estate registration bodies administer local registration matters; Zhejiang's platform claims public geographic-information services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custody and public GIS landing access were verified, but open parcel query coverage, schema, CRS, stable identity, and geometry access were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: A separate local or authenticated cadastral viewer may exist; no exact-point query was attempted because no anonymous usable parcel endpoint was identified. A zero-hit inference is not made.
